proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H
  constructor
  · intro hN g
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨g * h * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem h hh g, by group⟩
    · rintro ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨g⁻¹ * h * g, by simpa using hN.conj_mem h hh g⁻¹, by group⟩
  · intro hc
    refine ⟨fun n hn g => ?_⟩
    have hmem : g * n ∈ {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, x = g * h} := ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    rw [hc g] at hmem
    obtain ⟨h, hh, he⟩ := hmem
    rw [he]
    simpa using hh
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H : Subgroup G), H.Normal ↔ ∀ g : G, {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, x = g * h} = {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, x = h * g}
